mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening demand environment that depresses corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an impending slowdown in consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a severe labor market contraction that triggers recessionary fears and negative equity returns, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate revenue streams and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stagflationary pressures that prompt aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO declines, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
